sentence: This project builds ways to protect wireless networks from quantum computers and a system that switches to stronger protection during an attack.
This project studies silicon-based molecules that form complexes with metals and tests those complexes as catalysts for making organic materials.
This project builds artificial neural networks inside living cells so that stem cells turn into therapeutic cells without constant monitoring.
This project studies how the chemical additives in plastic affect cells, organisms and ecological communities.
This project studies how people find workarounds when artificial intelligence tools are imperfect and tests training that helps them.
This project builds and tests mathematical models of neural networks using neuronal activity and synaptic connections measured in zebrafish.
This project builds a framework and educational modules that help robotics researchers and engineers handle ethical risks.
This project studies how solidification and microstructure in additive manufacturing affect the magnetic performance of rare earth permanent magnets.
This project studies why collagen fibers deform permanently and how crosslinkers between the fibers affect this, using experiments and computational modeling.
This project develops a wireless networking framework that helps drones and robots communicate well both near to and far from a base station.
This project studies how a fungus in the guts of reptiles and amphibians affects gut bacteria and gets genes from them.
This project builds computational models that link the causes of evolution over short timescales to trait change over million-year timescales in mammals and fishes.
This project builds ways for users to check that cloud databases and serverless computing run as expected without trusting the cloud.
This project operates a facility that lends environmental sensing instruments to researchers measuring temperature, acoustics and topography.
This project studies how to protect artificial intelligence systems from cyber threats and how to use artificial intelligence for cyber defense.
This project designs loss functions that measure how accurate predictions are in machine learning and designs markets for the trade of predictions and data.
This project builds a software pipeline that detects positive selection in ancient and present-day human genomes.
